about.subtitle: Specialized in the development of automation systems for van and utility vehicle doors.
about.mission_text_1: AUTOMATIZA is a Brazilian company specialized in the development of automation systems for van and utility vehicle doors. Our mission is to bring technology, safety and practicality to those who live daily on the road, offering reliable solutions that facilitate the routine of drivers and transport companies throughout the country. 🚐⚙️
about.mission_text_2: From the beginning, AUTOMATIZA was born with a clear purpose: to modernize passenger access to transport vehicles, eliminating the repetitive effort of opening and closing doors manually and bringing more comfort to drivers and users.
about.innovation_subtitle: At AUTOMATIZA, we believe that innovation only makes sense when it solves real problems.
about.innovation_text: We develop automation systems designed for daily use in vehicles that operate intensely, such as school vans, executive transport, tourism and corporate fleets.
about.innovation_item_2: Greater safety in boarding and disembarking
about.innovation_item_3: Reduction of mechanical wear of the door
about.innovation_card_text: Each system is developed with a focus on durability, efficiency and ease of installation, ensuring a superior experience for our customers.
about.engineering_text: AUTOMATIZA constantly works on the improvement of its products, seeking to combine engineering, technology and practical market experience to deliver solutions that really work in the daily life of passenger transport.
about.models_footer: Variety that serves both self-employed drivers and companies with large fleets.
about.commitment_text_1: More than developing products, AUTOMATIZA seeks to build trust relationships with its customers. We know that those who work with transport need solutions that cannot fail.
about.commitment_text_2: Therefore, each system is designed to deliver consistent performance, safety and peace of mind in daily use. Our commitment is to continue evolving, investing in technology and developing solutions that make passenger transport more modern, efficient and comfortable.

how_to_buy.subtitle: Follow our steps and acquire your products simply and safely
how_to_buy.intro_title: Buying in our store is very easy!
how_to_buy.intro_text: We have developed an intuitive and secure purchasing process for your convenience. Follow the 6 steps below and your Automatiza products will arrive soon.
how_to_buy.step_1_desc: Browse between various product pages (automatic doors, launches, consumables, highlights) and click on the 'Buy' icon. Or click on 'View Product' for more information. The product will be inserted into your shopping cart.
how_to_buy.step_2_desc: Continue browsing our site until you choose all the products you want to purchase. You can add as many items as you wish. Click on 'Finish' when you are satisfied with your choices.
how_to_buy.step_3_desc: Enter with your email and password if you already have a registration with us. If you are not registered, register quickly by clicking on the 'Registration' link. The process is fast and secure, and you can manage your orders later.
how_to_buy.step_4_desc: Choose the shipping method of the product that best fits your needs. We work with JadLog and Rodonaves for automatic doors and Correios (Sedex) for other products. You will see the estimated term for each option.
how_to_buy.step_5_desc: Select the most convenient payment method for you: credit card, bank slip, bank transfer or other options. All payments are processed securely with SSL encryption.
how_to_buy.step_6_desc: You have acquired your Automatiza product! You will receive a confirmation email with the order number. Wait for the payment confirmation and your order will be sent within 5 business days.
how_to_buy.tip_text: If you have questions about which product to choose, consult our product pages or contact us by WhatsApp. Our team is ready to help!
how_to_buy.security_guarantee_text: All your data is protected with SSL encryption. You can buy with confidence knowing that your personal and payment information is safe.
how_to_buy.faq_a1: No, it is necessary to register or login to ensure delivery and tracking of your order. Registration is fast and simple.
how_to_buy.faq_q2: How long does it take for my order to arrive?
how_to_buy.faq_a2: The product is sent within 5 business days after payment confirmation. The delivery term varies according to the carrier and location.
how_to_buy.faq_q3: What is the best payment method?
how_to_buy.faq_a3: We offer several options: credit card, bank slip and bank transfer. Choose the one that best suits your needs.
how_to_buy.faq_a4: Yes! You will receive a tracking code by email. You can also contact us at (19) 99661-0774 for information.
